$schema_description: Master Studio Canonical Quiz Bank Template (Psychometric Rigor & Anti-Bias Standards)
subject: {{Subject_Folder_Name}}

_psychometric_invariants.rule_1_balanced_answer_keys: The correct answer MUST be uniformly distributed across A, B, C, D (approx 25% each, max 30% on any single letter). Never dump majority of answers into a single letter like B!
_psychometric_invariants.rule_2_uniform_option_length: Every distractor option MUST be within ±25% character length of the correct option. The correct answer MUST NEVER be visibly longer, more detailed, or qualified (longest-option tell)!
_psychometric_invariants.rule_3_plausible_distractors: Distractors must represent real student misconceptions, boundary oversights, or related algorithm conflations. Never write lazy, trivial, or joke options.
_psychometric_invariants.rule_4_bilingual_parity: Both English and Arabic translations must be provided for questions and options. Explanations must be thorough, citing formal standards or textbooks.
_psychometric_invariants.rule_5_clean_technical_terminology: NEVER perform clumsy literal translations followed by parenthetical English echoes (e.g. 'المعلومات (information)'). Technical industry terms (Scrum, OTP, MapReduce, KDD, Pipeline) must be written directly in clean English without brackets. General concepts must be clean Arabic without appending redundant English words in parentheses.
